subject: Request to reactivate trial + short credit top-up for Safeware PoC
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@safeware.io>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Reactivate trial + short extension for Safeware PoC

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here at Safeware liked the latency numbers and the ability to do private deployments was a big plus. We had a short internal pause while legal reviewed data retention, and our trial credits expired yesterday.

We’re about 70% through the PoC prompts and need another push of credits (or a short trial reactivation) to finish validation and share results with the CTO. Can you re-activate the trial or provide a one-time credit top-up for approximately 30k tokens / 30 days? We’re not ready to sign the MSA yet but would like to keep momentum.

Account: safeware-eval@safeware.io (trial started 2025-10-10)
Contact: Olivia Chen, Product Manager

If you need anything from legal/security, I can attach the questionnaire — I’ve included a short timeline: finish evaluation by 2025-11-30 and then present to the execs on 2025-12-03.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Product Manager, Safeware Inc.
olivia.chen@safeware.io
+1 415-555-0192

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the timeline. Happy to help. Two quick questions before I loop in the team for approval:

1) Can you confirm the exact account ID shown in the console (I see several "safeware" orgs sometimes)?
2) Is 30k tokens the minimum you need, or would a 10k–15k top-up plus a 14-day reactivation be sufficient?

If you want the faster path, send over the security questionnaire and I’ll copy Marcus (sales lead) and Rachel (CS) to get an approval and set up the onboarding slot.

—Neha

Team — forwarding Safeware's ask. Summary: account SAF-WARE-EVAL-7721; asking for one-time 30k token top-up / reactivate trial for 30 days to finish PoC (exec review 2025-12-03). They’re not ready to sign the MSA but would like to complete testing. Legal attached a filled questionnaire (see attachment).

Can we approve a one-time promotional top-up? If yes, please confirm promo code and whether we should add any usage caps. Also recommend offering a 60-minute onboarding from CS to accelerate results.

—Neha
